CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
S.I., Special Branch 9807
REPORT 27 / 40
Date February 27, 1940.

Subject CASSEDY, James Stephan - Communication from "Y" dated 20th
February 1940.

Made by. D.S. Henchman, Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford.

（批：Copy sent to 'D', with cl.）

James Stephan Cassedy, U.S. citizen in
possession of U.S. passport No. 650254, was born
in Woburn, Massachusetts, on 2nd April, 1906; he is
married but living apart from his wife.

Cassedy has been resident in China for
several years but has revisited his home in the
States on two or three occasions. For some time
he held the post of Professor of English at the
Catholic University in Peking and, at the present
time, is again living in that city. From September
until December in 1939, following a vacation spent
in the States, Cassedy was employed as a salesman
by the Sell Lumber Company in Shanghai and during
that period came to the notice of the S.M.P. in
connection with his unlawful possession of a pistol,
for which offence he served a term of 60 days
detention in Ward Road Gaol. Immediately subsequent
to his release from prison he left Shanghai for
Peking.

Cassedy is stated to be a man of good birth
and education but unreliable and inclined to alcoholic
excess. His wife, nee Sulivan, is living in the
U.S.A.; it is rumoured that she is a relative of
the United States Ambassador to Japan, Mr. Joseph
Grew. There is no record of Cassedy having been
attached to the U.S. Marine Corps.

A photograph of Cassedy is hereto attached.

（印：FILE）
（批：Gay.）

A.C. (Special Branch).
D. S.
（签名：D.S. Henchman）

报告 27 / 40
日期：1940年2月27日。

主题：CASSEDY，James Stephan —— 来自“Y”的函件，日期为1940年2月20日。

制作人：D.S. Henchman，转呈人：D.I. Crawford。

（批注：副本已送交‘D’，附卷宗。）

James Stephan Cassedy，美国公民，持有美国护照第650254号，于1906年4月2日出生于马萨诸塞州沃本；已婚，但与妻子分居。

Cassedy 已在中国居住数年，但曾两三次返回美国老家。他曾一度担任北京天主教大学（辅仁大学）英语教授一职，目前又居住在该市。1939年9月至12月期间，Cassedy 在美国度假归来后，受雇于上海的 Sell Lumber Company（塞尔木材公司）担任推销员，在此期间，因其非法持有手枪一事引起上海公共租界工部局警务处注意，并因此罪行在提篮桥监狱服刑60天。出狱后，他随即离开上海前往北京。

据称，Cassedy 出身良好且受过教育，但为人不可靠，且有酗酒倾向。其妻娘家姓 Sulivan（沙利文），现居美国；有传言称她是美国驻日本大使 Joseph Grew（格鲁）先生的亲戚。没有记录显示 Cassedy 曾隶属于美国海军陆战队。

随函附上 Cassedy 的照片一张。

（印章：归档）
（批注：Gay。）

A.C.（特别支部）。
D. S.
（签名：D.S. Henchman）

SECRET February 20th, 1940.

Is there anything in Police records
concerning an American named JAMES S.
CASSIDY or CASSEDY believed to have been
a member of the United States Marine Corps.
at one time?

"Y"

DS thompson
C 1/2
